relations.rationale: Eli being team captain is consistent with Eli bringing supplies, but does not establish it.
Eli's captaincy has no bearing on Kai's volunteering for raffle tickets.
Fay's relative age to Kai says nothing about how long Fay has been a member.
Fay being younger than Kai does not indicate anything about Kai's membership duration.
Fay's age relative to Kai has no connection to Cleo's height relative to Kai.
Fay's age relative to Kai is unrelated to Kira's height relative to Fay.
Fay's age relative to Kai does not relate to Fay and Kira's teamwork habits.
Fay's relative age has no bearing on Cleo's competition ranking.
Fay's age relative to Kai does not affect Kai's competition placement.
Fay's age relative to Kai has nothing to do with the weather forecast.
Fay's long membership does not imply anything about Kai's membership duration.
Fay's membership duration has no connection to the physical layout of tables.
Kai's membership duration is unrelated to the height-based reasoning about reaching the crane.
Kai's membership duration does not relate to the order of arrival between Kai and Cleo.
Kai's membership duration has no bearing on the table layout.
Kai's membership duration does not relate to Fay's testing of the points.
Fay knowing the wiring diagrams well does not imply or preclude Kai also knowing them well.
Fay's knowledge of wiring diagrams is unrelated to the order in which Fay and Kai arrived.
Fay's wiring knowledge has no connection to Kira's height relative to Fay.
Fay's skill with wiring diagrams could plausibly support the claim that she frequently collaborates with Kira on signal boxes, which involve similar technical work.
